other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage through LightGBM Reference Dataset
other_failure_modes.description: Using the entire un-split dataset as the reference dataset for a training fold in LightGBM causes feature bin boundaries to be computed using the validation data, leaking the validation distribution into the training process.

other_failure_modes.name: Early Stopping without Validation Set
